title: Abbas e Alamdaar
body:
Chadar e Zainab ka nighedar Abbas e Alamdar
Lashkar e Shabbir ka Salar Abbas e Alamdar
Dete Ladne Ki Raza Jo Shahe Jinn o Bashar
Door Tak Aate Nahi Ran Mein Kuffar Nazar
Aapse Phir Bhi Koi, Ladne Aajata Agar
Jism Se Hota Juda, Uska Kuch Lamhon Mei Sar
Hoti Jafa Ki Khatm Wahaan Zindagi
Fauj e yazeedi mei nahi Bachta koi
Milti agar aapko talwaar Abbas e Alamdaar
Nehr Pe Pohach Gaye, Mashk Paani Se Bhari
Apne Rahwaar Se Phir Bole Yeh Ibne Ali
Tu bhI Pyaasa Hai Bohat Thoda Pii Lee Paani
Sar Jhuka Kar Yeh Faras Ne Kaha Ay Ghazi
Bachche Hai Pyaase Paani Piun Kis Tarha
Naam E Sakina Pe Nahi Paani Piya
Pyaasa Raha Aapka Rahwaar Abbas e Alamdaar
Haye Ashoor Ke Din Tha Qayamat Ka Samaañ
Kham Kamar Thaame Huwe Aur Liye Khushk Zabaañ
Aaye Ghazi ke qareeN, Malik e Kaun o Makaañ
Sar Ko Zanu Pe Rakha, Bole Yeh Shahe Zamaañ
Aap Ne Tifli Se Humme Aaqa Kaha
Kardo Ay Ghazi Pura Yeh Armaañ Mera
Bhai Bhi Kehdo Humme Ek baar Abbas e Alamdaar
Jab Rasan Basta Huwe, Roke Zainab Ne Kaha
Tasnalab Sher E Jari,ay Sakina Ke Chacha
Uth Ke Dekho Toh Zara,ay Alamdaar E Wafa
Jaa Rahi Hai Yeh Behan,chord Kar Karbobala
Baad Tumhare, Aise Hai Badla Jahaan
Na Koi Mehmil Na Hai Koi Saebaan
Chalne Ko Hai Kafela Tayyar Abbas e Alamdar
Hai Yeh Atif Ki Dua Ay Shahenshaahe Wafa
Aake Rauze Pe Tumhare Woh Pade Yeh Nauha
Ho Surani Pe Karam Ay Wafaon Ke Khuda
Yunhi Likhta Woh Rahe Aapke Nauhe Sadaa
Bab E Hawaij Dil Ki Hai Yeh Ilteja
Baali Sakina Ka Hai Tumhe Vaasta
Hum Bhi Bane Aapke Zawwaar, Abbas E Alamdaar
